policy: final_checks.json is not renamed in place and its values are not overwritten. This keymap states, for each misnamed key, the effective window or construction and the stored file that holds the corrected value. The producing script scripts/analysis_paper3v2_final_checks.py is not rerun for this purpose.

key_maps.effective_record: 1993 to 2017 (the ECCO-V4r4 record in this file ends in 2017; ecco.record = [1992, 2017])

units.mean_F_ov_Sv: Sv (record mean, annual-mean estimator in this block)
units.transport_share: dimensionless ratio; not meaningful where the total trend is near zero (ECCO-V4r4)

superseded_blocks.reason: annual-mean estimator; does not match Table S2(a)

no_interval_keys.frozen_field_intervals: final_checks.json has no interval keys for the frozen-field split; the intervals are in PAPER_3_v2/analysis/jc_r2_G07_frozen_epochs_intervals.json

ecco_transport_share: 2.38 (1993 to 2017) and 2.16 are not meaningful and are not to be printed (see CANONICAL_FACTS.md section 48)

r1_vertical_grid.json.status: no producing script is in scripts/ or PAPER_3_v2 (checked); retire the file and cite jc_r2_G03_headline.json
r1_vertical_grid.json.reason: the keys used and alternative name different constructions across products

jc_n04_ar_recalibration.json.summary.sieve_share_coverage_pct: stylised configuration only (AR(2) in both series, true shares 0.1 and 0.5, correlation 0.5); not ORAS5 coverage
jc_n04_ar_recalibration.json.summary.sieve_halfwidth_inflation_for_95: stylised configuration only; not applied to ORAS5 intervals

en4.json.reanalysis_same_window: holds reanalysis own salinity (pair B), not EN4; rename to reanalysis_own_salinity_own_circulation in a later script revision (not done)
